war_summary: War 139 is in conquest mode (32 victory towns required, no winner yet) with a fragmented front: many regions are fully held by one faction, but intense localized fighting is concentrated in a few hotspots. Colonial forces control broad territories including Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast, and others, while Wardens hold strong pockets such as Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, and Reaching Trail. The heaviest pressure is in Stlican Shelf (26 recent events, massive casualty spikes, bases flipping repeatedly), The Moors/Mooring County (22 events, 10-2 Colonial base lead but constant turnover), The Clahstra (21 events, 6-2 Warden split with high casualties), Oarbreaker Isles (21 events, 4-4-1 split with neutral involvement), Onyx (15 events, 3-3 deadlock), and Endless Shore (8 events, 7-3 Warden split). Uncertainty remains because high event volumes in Stlican Shelf coincide with a current 9-0 Warden ownership snapshot, suggesting rapid recapture cycles or snapshot lag; the 3.11-hour history window also limits momentum assessment, and casualty ratios are near parity in the hottest zones, making 24-hour strategic-base predictions highly contingent on reinforcement flows not visible here.
